title: Choose the dashboard layout
question: Managers land on this page every morning. Pick the layout; the ROWD look is already set, this choice is about what sits where.

options.label: Roadmap first
options.thesis: The year's modules on one timeline, with what needs you pinned to each module's bar.
options.viewport: A full-width roadmap (months across, a today line, one bar per module with its progress inside and badges like '3 to review'), then the 'Needs you' list and today's team summary below.
options.risk: Strong when modules have start and end dates; modules without dates drop off the roadmap and need a fallback row.

options.label: Module stack
options.thesis: Every module is a ROWD module shape whose progress fills it, stacked like the brand mark.
options.viewport: One ruled summary strip of today's numbers, then the modules as wide rounded rows (progress filling each row, due date, tasks done, attention badges), with the 'Needs you' queue in a side rail.
options.risk: Most on-brand, but with 30+ modules the stack gets long; it needs grouping and a compact mode.

options.label: Action inbox
options.thesis: Everything waiting on the manager in one list, opened beside it without leaving the page.
options.viewport: Tabs (All, To review, Overdue, To-dos) over a list of items on one side; the selected submission or task opens on the other side with Approve / Request changes; modules sit in a compact strip at the bottom.
options.risk: Fastest for clearing work, but modules and the roadmap move down the page, so it reads less like an overview.
